prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1348; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for the claim file. Can you please state your full name for the record?

A: I'd rather just go by my first name for now, if that's all right.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was stopped at a light on a main road in Sugar Land, near one of the big intersections by the shopping center. I was in the left lane waiting to turn.

Q: Okay. What happened next?

A: The light was red and I had been sitting there for a bit. Then I felt a hard jolt from behind. The car was pushed forward into the intersection area a little bit.

Q: Did you see the vehicle that hit you before the impact?

A: No, I never saw it coming. I was looking at the light and my phone was in the cup holder. I didn't see anything in the mirror until the moment it hit.

Q: Did you get out of your vehicle and speak with the other driver?

A: Yes, he came over and said he didn't see that the traffic had stopped. He seemed shaken up but okay. We exchanged information and the police came to the scene.

Q: How are you feeling physically since the collision?

A: My neck is really stiff and sore, and the pain goes up into my head sometimes. I've had headaches most days. Turning my head to check my blind spot is hard now. I went to urgent care the next morning and they said it looked like whiplash.

Q: Have you been seeing a doctor or therapist since then?

A: I have a follow-up appointment next week and I'm doing some physical therapy exercises at home for now.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Just that I was following the rules and I want my medical bills taken care of. I'm still working out how much time I'll need off.

Q: Understood. Thank you for your cooperation today. We'll be in touch with next steps.
